problem: Agents starting fresh sessions lack domain context (temporal model, glossary, oracle isolation). Broken links, wrong citations, and a task-selection bug in context-package.py compound the issue.
proposed_solution: Create 4 new files (temporal-model.md, glossary.md, project_domain.mdc, AGENTS.md), fix 3 broken links + 1 stale citation, fix context-package.py priority sorting, add verification script.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: .cursor/rules/project_domain.mdc exists, has alwaysApply: true, and line count <= 60
AC-2: docs/temporal-model.md exists with sections 'Investigation-time visibility', 'Eval-only oracle', 'Worked example'. Contains 'eval-only' adjacent to 'jira' (case-insensitive)
AC-3: docs/glossary.md defines these 8 minimum terms: buggy, fix_hash, SUPPORTED, oracle isolation, wrong-mechanism, judge_oracle, historical defect context, bug_hash
AC-4: AGENTS.md exists at repo root with markdown links to docs/temporal-model.md, docs/glossary.md, docs/architecture.md, .harness/state.json
AC-5: Broken links fixed: evaluation.md no longer references nonexistent prompt-engineering-ceiling.md at original path; patterns.md does not reference nonexistent FOUNDATIONS.md
AC-6: rg 'McIntosh.*2021' docs/datasets.md returns 0 matches; Keshavarz or 5907847 appears in docs/datasets.md
edge_cases: EC-1: Temporal worked example must label ALL JIRA fields as eval-only unless --enable-jira-context flag exists in run_eval.py --help
EC-2: context-package.py sorts tasks by priority field; if priority is missing, falls back to array order (tasks without priority sort after those with priority)
verification_method: Run scripts/check-docs.sh (exits 0 = all ACs pass). For EC-1: inspect docs/temporal-model.md worked example section for JIRA eval-only labeling. For EC-2: run python smoke test on context-package.py _active_task with mixed priority/no-priority tasks. Run pytest to confirm no regressions (481 tests).
